sections.title: Charanam 2

sections.title: Charanam 3
lyrics: navarasamulakanna navaritha mulakanTe - adhikamow nee nAma mEmi ruchirA

sections.title: Charanam 6

sections.title: Charanam 7
lyrics: sharaNanna janulanu saraguNa rakshinchu - birudhu gadigina nAma mEmi ruchirA

sections.title: Charanam 8
lyrics: tumburu nAradulDamba miraga gA - nambu jEseDi nAma mEmi ruchirA
